newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE revises commodity futures trading hours.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE revises commodity futures trading hours.

text.p: The London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange (LIFFE) said trading hours for some commodity contracts would be revised effective January 20.
LIFFE said the slightly revised times followed a revision of its trading proceduces for floor-traded commodity contracts due to take effect on the same day.
The revised trading hours would affect cocoa, BIFFEX, coffee futures and their related options contracts.
"Included within these amendments are alterations to the closing process for particular commodity contracts which slightly impact upon the closing times for those contracts," a LIFFE statement said.
Under the changes, cocoa futures would end the morning session at 12.25 P.M. London time instead of 12.28. The afternoon session would be extended by 10 minutes to 16.55 PM from 16.45.

The BIFFEX futures would close the day at 16.40 P.M. instead of 16.30 while coffee futures would have its morning session cut by two minutes to 12.30 P.M. -- Jalil Hamid, London newsroom +44 171 542 4985
